set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN's ID number, for the sole identification of a VLAN.

set protocols stp bridge-priority 8.explanation: The command sets the Spanning Tree Protocol (STP) bridge priority to `[parameter1]`, influencing root bridge election in the network.

parameters.name: bridge-priority
parameters.explanation: The higher the value of the STP Bridge, the smaller the priority.

vlan vlan-100.explanation: Configure the STP bridge priority and associated VLAN.

unit 0 family ethernet-switching port-mo.explanation: Configures the interface with trunk exchange mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: port-mode
parameters.explanation: Port mode for interfaces, such as trunk.

unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan me.command: unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members vlan-100
unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan me.explanation: Configure the VLAN members of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: vlan-members
parameters.explanation: VLAN members of interfaces, such as Vlan-100.
